question: Eddie is thinking of a number that is divisible by both 8 and 5. What is the smallest possible number that Eddie could be thinking of?

Heather enjoys bird-watching and observed two types of birds traveling this season: ducks and seagulls. While the ducks traveled in flocks of 18, the seagulls traveled in flocks of 10. If Heather observed the same total number of ducks and seagulls, what is the smallest number of ducks that she could have observed?

Joe's Bath Shop sells bars of soap in boxes of 5 bars and bottles of soap in boxes of 19 bottles. An employee is surprised to discover that the shop sold the same number of bars and bottles last week. What is the smallest number of each type of soap that the shop could have sold?
Trevor counted 77 coins in his bank. He counted 29 quarters. The rest are dimes. How many more coints of the total than quarts does Trevor have?
Laurie has 12 more marbles than Kurt. Kurt has 45 marbles less than Dennis. Dennis has 70 marbles. How many marbles does Laurie have?
Anthony gets 75 cents every day for lunch. He bought a juice box for 27 cents. He also bought a cupcake. Anthony had 8 cents left. How much did the cupcake cost?
The third graders are having a fair. They have 90 tickets to sell. They sold 38 tickets the first week and 17 tickets the second week. How many tickets do they have left to sell?
Mario made 18 posters to help advertise the fair. Samantha made 15 more posters than Mario. How many posters did they make altogether?
Jasper is in charge of the refreshments. He sold 27 bags of chips. He sold 8 fewer hot dogs than chips. He sold 12 more drinks than hot dogs. How many drinks did Jasper sell?

Jake set up a candy stand in his front yard. He has 80 pieces of candy to sell. He sold 15 pieces of candy on Monday. He sold much more than that on Tuesday. By Wednesday, Jakes only had 7 pieces left. How many pieces of candy did Jake sell on Tuesday?

The ski resort reported 65 inches of snow in January. They measured 18 inches of snow during the first week. They measured 25 inches of snow the second week. How much snow did they get the rest of the month?

Corey earns extra money finding lost golf balls. His goal is to find 48 golfballs every weekend. He found 16 golf balls on Saturday. He found 18 more golf balls on Sunday. How many more golf balls does Corey need to find to reach his goal?
The Greene family went to the amusement park. They spent $45 on admission tickets. They spent $13 less than that on food. How much did the Greene family spend in all?
Ben had 18 marbles and John had 17 marbles. Ben gave half of his marbles to John. How many more marbles did John have than Ben then?
Jean had a bag of candy. She gave 18 pieces to her friend. Jean ate 7 pieces. Now she has 16 pieces left. How many pieces of candy did Jean have at first?

William sells hot dogs at the ball park. He sold 19 hot dogs during the first three innings. He sold 27 hot dogs during the next three innings. William had 45 hot dogs left to sell. How many hot dogs did William have at first?
Charlene made 60 bead necklaces. She sold 16 at a craft fair. She gave 18 to her friends. How many necklaces did Charlene have then?
The coach bought 2 extra large pizzas for the team. There were 32 slices of pizza totally. After the team ate some of the slices, there were 7 slices left. How many slices of pizza did the team eat?
There are 42 boys in the computer club. There are 9 fewer girls than boys in the club. How many children are in the computer club altogether?
Amy has 67 balloons. 29 of them are red and 17 are green. The rest of the balloons are blue. How many blue balloons does Amy have?
52 children and 29 adults went to the track meet. The stadium has 95 seats. How many seats were empty?

Mr. Lee gave out first place ribbons after each event. He had 38 ribbons at the start. He gave away 14 ribbons in the morning. He gave out 16 ribbons in the afternoon. How many ribbons did Mr. Lee have left?
Alvin had 57 marbles and played two games. He lost 18 marbles during the first game. He won 25 marbles during the second game. How many marbles did Alvin have then?
Joey checked his pockets for money. He found 17 cents in his pants pocket. He found 24 cents more than that in his jacket pocket. How much money did Joey find altogether?
Cheryl and Lori started a lemonade stand on Friday. They bought 85 plastic cups. They sold a lot of lemonade and only had 18 cups left. How many cups did Cheryl and Lori use?
